meaning: Two thin metal rods on top of a TV that caught TV signals from the air. You moved them to clear up the picture.
clues: It helped a TV pick up shows from the air.
It was two thin metal rods that stuck up from a base.
Shows came through the air from a tower, so you had to point it the right way.
Turning it a bit could clear up a fuzzy picture.
It has two words. The first is an animal with long ears.
